items.requirement: Inspect HTML revalidation, immutable hashed assets and previous-release retention as hosting dependencies without silently modifying server infrastructure.

conditions.condition: Inspect and record actual or unavailable evidence for HTML revalidation, immutable hashed assets and previous-release asset retention.
conditions.rationale: Each of HTML revalidation, immutable hashed assets and prior-release retention is explicitly inspected at source level and recorded as unavailable for actual host enforcement. Unavailable evidence is an allowed explicit outcome of this condition.

conditions.condition: Document hosting requirements and responsible deployment follow-up without changing server infrastructure under frontend approval.
conditions.rationale: Snapshot assigns actual-host evidence and recovery verification to the deployment/hosting operator before separate deployment approval. Relevant existing rollback/hosting paragraphs are preserved verbatim with source attribution; no infrastructure action is performed.
